1.Title: The chaotic timeline has begun, and the fateful duel is soon to arrive.
1.Info:
As soon as Orthros had sensed the presence of the alternate timeline, his strategic battle with Zolrath had already begun. One sought to realign destiny and correct its course, while the other aimed to shred the fabric of time, dissolving order with countless divergences and anomalies.
When the forces of Orthros and Zolrath collided in the depths of time, they tore open a rift that pierced chronology itself, causing a distorted, chaotic realm to take shape—one altogether detached from the normal temporal order. Turbulence in the flow of time rippled out from the rift, drawing some unwitting Esperians into its swirling maw.
And thus, amidst these disordered threads of time, Orthros and Zolrath fight for control over the alternate timeline. If the cosmos is to heal this rift, one side must win—so everyone must pick a faction.
The chimes of fate have been struck. You, adventurer! For which side will you fight?

2.Title: Wild Adventures
2.Info: Explore the ruins in the wild and encounter random events. Gather various supplies for battle preparation.

3.Title: Phantom Hunt
3.Info: You are being ambushed by a bizarre phantom. Assemble your allies and give chase!

4.Title: Perilous Prelude
4.Info: The rulers of time, Orthros and Zolrath, may unleash temporal chaos, reigniting a cosmic conflict.

5.Title: Repair Chrono Cores
5.Info: Support your faction by repairing Chrono Cores to prepare for victory in the Conflict Phase.

6.Title: Final Duel
6.Info: The duels commence in all three battlefields. Challenge the enemy force to obtain Battle Fervor and score a victory.

7.Title: Destroy Chrono Cores
7.Info: Destroy the enemy's Chrono Cores while defending your own. That will determine the outcome of this temporal conflict!

8.Title: Defeat Monsters
8.Info: Work together to defeat powerful monsters and gather the energy you'll need during the Decisive Battle.
